package: USON-6 (DNP) 2.0 x 2.0 mm with thermal pad

footprint_drawing.source: OPT4001-Q1 ds SBOSA93E p53-57 (outline and land pattern; not transcribed)
footprint_drawing.note: near miss to check against p54: Package_SON:WSON-6-1EP_2x2mm_P0.65mm_EP1x1.6mm. Thermal pad must be soldered (p56 note 3).

circuit.page: [mem] typical; application section p37+ not read line by line

logic: I2C and INT pins 5.5 V tolerant, pull-ups 1.6-5.5 V (p4, p6-7). 3.3 V bus direct.

i2c_addr.select: ADDR pin: GND 0x44, VDD 0x45, SDA 0x46, SCL 0x47 (p22). 0x45 chosen to keep 0x44 free.

placement: Under the clear window. Angular response 120 deg full width at half maximum for the USON package (p6): window radius = sensor radius + gap x tan(60 deg) for the full response, so keep the gap small.
TI notes it also works under visibly dark, infrared-transmissive glass (p12-13); here a clear window is shared with the AS7341.
notes: The stocked code is the automotive OPT4001-Q1 in the USON (DNP) package: use the OPT4001-Q1 data sheet, not the OPT4001 one (which only covers PicoStar and SOT-5X3).
Non-automotive OPT4001DTSR (SOT-5X3) has 112 in stock, OPT4001YMNR 0: do not use.
unverified: Land pattern dimensions and thermal pad size (p53-57).
